Metadata.title: PURGE — Reset a Windows PC
Metadata.description: A guided Windows journey to identify internal drives, erase everything and return to the first-time setup screen.

Hero.lede: A verified journey to identify every internal drive, confirm the scope and reset Windows.

Use.summary: Four actions to cover every internal drive.
Use.stepDownloadText: Download the package and extract it to a folder.
Use.stepLaunchText: Open Purge.cmd, then accept the UAC prompt.
Use.stepConfirmText: In the window, type exactly NETTOYER TOUS LES DISQUES.
Use.stepResetText: In Windows, choose Remove everything, then All drives when multiple drives are present, and Fully clean the drive.
Use.cleanData: Enable Clean data. When multiple drives are present, select All drives. Windows consumer cleaning is not forensic proof.

Demo.label: PURGE DEMO
Demo.summary: A complete demonstration of downloading, launching, checking and resetting Windows.
Demo.autoplay: The video starts automatically without sound. Use the controls to pause, resume or replay the demonstration.
Demo.fallback: Your browser cannot play this video.

After.summary: PURGE covers the internal drives, then stops before the next user’s setup.
After.restart: Windows applies the reset and restarts automatically.
After.initialScreen: The computer returns to the first Windows setup.
